backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Becoming habit tracker app, managing user profiles, time zones, habits with monthly completion states, and volume tracking (reps/time), with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the Monthly Volume Summary update (Plank/Squash time metrics + Press-ups/Squats reps retention) to its implementation files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary catalog describing the purpose and key behaviors of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up QueryClientProvider, renders the glassmorphic header with auth controls, DailyMotivationalQuote banner, BecomingView, footer with caffeine.ai attribution, and Toaster notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via Internet Identity, with an embedded LoginButton.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge component that displays the current authentication state ('Signed in' or 'Not signed in') based on Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button component handling Internet Identity login and logout, with loading state and query cache clearing on sign-out.
frontend/src/components/quotes/DailyMoti: Displays a daily motivational quote with loading skeleton and fallback error state, sourced from the useDailyZenQuote hook.
frontend/src/components/quotes/TimeZoneI: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for habits CRUD and completion toggling, using useActorWithTimeout for actor access, normalizing errors, applying optimistic updates, and compounding volume tracking with habit-name-aware Squash/Plank progression rules.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view component for the Becoming feature that orchestrates habit display, handling authentication state, loading skeletons, error banners, and rendering the habit grid with monthly tabs and progress charts.
Displays a destructive alert banner with a user-friendly error message and an optional retry button when habit loading fails.
Renders a skeleton placeholder UI mimicking the habit grid layout with month tabs, header row, and habit rows while data is loading.
Modal dialog for editing a habit's name, unit type, and volume, with validation for time and reps inputs and mutations to persist changes.
Renders a scrollable grid of habit rows with a day-number header for the selected month, or an empty state message if no habits exist.
Exports shared layout constants and helper functions (column widths, CSS grid template builder) used to align habit grid headers and checkbox columns consistently.
Provides an inline form to add a new habit by name, toggling between a button and an input field with add/cancel actions.
Renders a single habit row with a clickable info cell showing name, unit, volume, and monthly total, plus per-day checkboxes for toggling completion.
A popover component wrapping a habit row trigger that shows an 'Edit habit' action button when opened.
Displays aggregated monthly volume totals (reps, plank time, squash time) for habits that have volume tracking, conditionally rendering each metric.
Renders a tab bar for selecting a month from the 2026 months list, highlighting the active month with a bottom border.

Renders a grouped bar chart showing yearly habit progress (press-ups, squats, plank, squash) across all months of the current year, with a custom tooltip displaying values in appropriate units (reps or hours).
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Defines a typed array of month metadata (name, short name, days, index) for all 12 months of 2026, plus helper functions to retrieve month info and day counts by index.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Provides the core habit data model, including types, completion map builders, and functions to query completion status, count completed days, and compute monthly/yearly volume totals with support for time and rep-based units.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Utility functions for validating, parsing, formatting, and normalizing time strings in M:SS or M format, converting between minutes, seconds, and display strings.
frontend/src/features/quotes/hooks/useDa: Custom React hook that fetches the daily zen quote via the backend actor, parses the 'text - author' format, and schedules an automatic refetch at the next 8am UK time.
frontend/src/features/quotes/utils/ukQuo: Exports a single utility function that calculates the number of milliseconds until the next 08:00 UK time (Europe/London), accounting for GMT/BST transitions, with a 5-second buffer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor instance using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Enhanced version of useActor that races actor initialization against a 15-second timeout, normalizes errors, and exposes a manual retry trigger alongside the actor and loading/error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Computer Internet Identity authentication, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via an `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapper component.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS that defines a light cyber-professional theme with OKLCH CSS variables for colors, glassmorphism utilities, and mobile touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Utility functions for detecting and handling Internet Computer replica rejection errors, specifically stopped-canister scenarios (IC0508/reject_code 5), with user-friendly message formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH-based color tokens, custom border radii, Space Grotesk font family, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for a fitness tracking app, documenting existing features, pending feature requests, and architectural notes about time-based vs. rep-based activity metrics.
